k:限.mnemonic: A stubborn (艮) guard stands on the mound (阝) at the edge of the land and will not let anyone take a single step further. Limit (restrict, to best of ability).

k:波.mnemonic: The surface of the sea ripples like the pelt (皮) of a running animal, and each ripple is a small cousin of a tsunami (氵). Waves (billows, Poland).

k:例.mnemonic: The leader (亻) pulls one soldier out of the file (列) and stands him in front: 'Look at him. Do it like this.' Example (custom, usage, precedent).

k:失.mnemonic: A person (人) carrying something far too big (大) for their arms. It slips, drops out the side, and is gone before they notice. Lose (error, fault, loss).
k:失.hint: Too much to carry, something drops.

k:御.mnemonic: When the lord takes a stroll (彳), everyone must stop (止) and bow until his attendant gives the stamp (卩) of permission to rise. Honorable (govern, reign, rule).
k:御.hint: Everyone bows to the strolling lord.

k:忠.mnemonic: One name written in the very middle (中) of the heart (心), with no room beside it for another master. Loyalty (fidelity, faithfulness).
k:忠.hint: One master at the heart's centre.

k:麻.mnemonic: A drying shed with a sloping roof, and under it two tall stalks hung side by side, waiting to be twisted into rope. Hemp (flax, numb).

k:悪.mnemonic: A lid, one (一) heavy stroke, pressed down on loyalty (忠) until it is crushed out of shape. Faithfulness squashed flat turns into its opposite. Bad (vice, rascal, evil).

k:歴.mnemonic: Under the overhang (厂) of the workshop, apprentices learn hemp (麻) rope-making step by step, and may not stop (止) until every stage is passed. Curriculum (continuation, passage of time, continue).

k:左.mnemonic: On a construction (工) site, one (一) hand holds the ruler steady while the other slides (ノ) the pencil along it. The hand that holds is this one. Left.

k:佐.mnemonic: Standing just to the left (左) of the leader (亻), holding his papers and whispering names in his ear. Assistant (help).

k:林.mnemonic: One tree (木) and then another beside it: a small stand of trunks, enough for shade but not enough to get lost in. Grove (forest).

k:紙.mnemonic: The clan (氏) pounds old thread (糸) and rag into pulp, spreads it thin on a screen and dries it into white sheets for the family records. Paper.

k:観.mnemonic: A hunter with an arrow (矢) on the string climbs the ridge to see (見) where the turkey (隹) flock is feeding. From up there the whole valley opens out. Outlook (look, appearance, view).

k:論.mnemonic: 'Say (言) that again, now (今)!' One scholar thumps a tome (冊) on the desk to prove his point, and the other reaches for a thicker one. Argument (discourse).

k:降.mnemonic: Ten (十) weary climbers trudge (夂) back down the mound (阝) as the rain starts to fall on them. Descend (precipitate, fall, surrender).

k:児.mnemonic: Tiny legs (儿) that still bend (曲) up against the belly, the way they were folded before birth. Newborn babe (child, young of animals, kid).

k:述.mnemonic: Walking the path (辶), your guide points: 'By the way, that tree (木) is ten (十) centuries old.' Said in passing, and on you go. Mention (state, speak, relate).

k:春.mnemonic: The first warm day (日) of the year: a person (人) steps outside, turns their face up to heaven (天) and feels the sun on it again. Springtime (spring).
k:春.hint: Face turned up to warm sun.

k:返.mnemonic: Walk the path (辶) in the anti- (反) direction, against the way you came, and you end up back where you started. Return (answer, fade, repay).

k:域.mnemonic: A guard with a halberd (戈) stands at the mouth (口) of the valley. All the soil (土) behind him is his people's land. Region (range, limits, level).

k:飛.mnemonic: A crane taking off: the long neck rising at the top and two wings, one above the other, each with its feathers flicking in the air. Fly (scatter).

k:備.mnemonic: Before the task (用) of the climb, the leader (亻) lays everything out under the overhang (厂): ropes, lamps, even flowers (艹) for the summit shrine. Equip (provision, preparation).
k:備.hint: Gear laid out before the climb.

k:宗.mnemonic: Under one roof (宀) the priest holds up the sacred objects to show (示) the kneeling people what they believe in. Religion (sect, denomination, origin).

k:察.mnemonic: A tent (癶) goes up at the edge of town with chanting inside. You cannot see in, so you listen and work out which religion (宗) it must be. Guess (presume, surmise, judge).

k:更.mnemonic: The farmer went into the rice field (田) at dawn (旦) and is still there. The shadows are long, the lamp is lit, and he works on. Grow late (night watch, sit up late, renew).
k:更.hint: Still in the field since sunrise.

k:須.mnemonic: The rule book's first page (頁) says so plainly: before meeting the emperor, whiskers (彡) must be combed. No exceptions. Ought (by all means, necessarily).

k:医.mnemonic: A crate (匚) of instruments is opened and the arrow (矢) is drawn carefully out of the soldier's shoulder. Doctor (medicine).

k:顔.mnemonic: You stand (立) at a funeral under the overhang (厂) of your hat brim, knowing how you ought (須) to look, and arrange your face to match. Expression (face, surface).
k:顔.hint: Arranging your face under a brim.

k:防.mnemonic: The flood always comes from the same direction (方), so the villagers pile up a mound (阝) of earth on that side to keep it out. Prevent (defend, ward off, protect).
k:防.hint: Earth bank on the flood side.
